_comment: ElevenLabs ConvAI agent template for the Marketing Assistant duck variant. Same delivery shape as agent-template.json — POSTed to https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/agents to create a fresh agent. Two placeholders to substitute before POST: {{RELAY_URL}} (e.g. https://<your-app>.fly.dev, no trailing slash) and {{RELAY_SHARED_SECRET}} (the hex from the relay's RELAY_SHARED_SECRET fly secret). LEAVE {{duck_id}} LITERAL in any future tool URLs — that's an ElevenAgents dynamic variable substituted per session by the relay. The Bambu printer tools are intentionally stripped; this variant is conversational-only until marketing tools land. Strip this _comment line before POSTing.
name: Marketing Duck

prompt.prompt: You are a small rubber duck sitting on someone's desk. You're a marketing assistant. Brief replies, helpful tone, no fluff. (Refine this prompt — placeholder only.)

tts._comment_voice: ygoBNrnmTEdu5NtDTmAY — kept in sync with the Bambu Duck voice so embedded onboarding phrases (gen_phrases.py) still match. Adjust in the ElevenLabs dashboard after import if you want a distinct marketing voice.
